entities.summary: John Wyer, was an English automobile racing engineer and team manager. He is mainly associated with cars running in the light blue and orange livery of his longtime sponsor Gulf Oil. John Wyer was a architects & engineers from Kidderminster (1909-12-11, Kidderminster–1989-04-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
